atoms.exact_source_text: Every Queue entry has a defined result, a related Role, a material requirement where appropriate, and a required quantity of committed Role labor.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every Queue entry has a defined result, a related Role, a material requirement where appropriate, and a required quantity of committed Role labor.

atoms.exact_source_text: While a Citizen services the Project Queue, their Role Capacity is committed to that entry.
atoms.normalized_claim: While a Citizen services the Project Queue, their Role Capacity is committed to that entry.

atoms.exact_source_text: If several Citizens provide the same Role, only committed Capacity is suspended.
atoms.normalized_claim: If several Citizens provide the same Role, only committed Capacity is suspended.

atoms.exact_source_text: Uncommitted Capacity continues ordinary coverage.
atoms.normalized_claim: Uncommitted Capacity continues ordinary coverage.

atoms.exact_source_text: > **A Citizen may maintain the Colony’s ordinary function or deliberately change what the Colony can do. They do not perform both with the same civic share.**
atoms.normalized_claim: A Citizen may maintain the Colony's ordinary function or deliberately change what the Colony can do, but a Citizen does not perform both with the same civic share.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Project is enacted through the Project Queue by its related Role.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Project is enacted through the Project Queue by its related Role.

atoms.exact_source_text: The related Role is determined by the Project’s principal civic function, not simply by whether material is moved.
atoms.normalized_claim: The related Role is determined by the Project's principal civic function, not simply by whether material is moved.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Gardener therefore enacts a Winter Cultivation adaptation even when the Project consumes Scrap.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Gardener enacts a Winter Cultivation adaptation even when the Project consumes Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: A developmental MEET does not instantly upgrade a Place.
atoms.normalized_claim: A developmental MEET does not instantly upgrade a Place.

atoms.exact_source_text: > **World experience → developmental threshold → Home MEET → Practice or decision → Project Queue entry → completed Place function**
atoms.normalized_claim: The developmental sequence is: World experience, then developmental threshold, then Home MEET, then Practice or decision, then Project Queue entry, then completed Place function.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools are produced through the same Project Queue.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools are produced through the same Project Queue.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Tool class has a simple Scrap recipe.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Tool class has a simple Scrap recipe.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool entry is serviced by a Crafter.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool entry is serviced by a Crafter.

atoms.exact_source_text: Committed Crafter Capacity does not provide ordinary passive Crafting.
atoms.normalized_claim: Committed Crafter Capacity does not provide ordinary passive Crafting.

atoms.exact_source_text: Completion creates one persistent Tool.
atoms.normalized_claim: Completion creates one persistent Tool.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tool-making is a deliberate opportunity cost.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool-making is a deliberate opportunity cost.

atoms.exact_source_text: Ordinary maintenance belongs to passive Role function.
atoms.normalized_claim: Ordinary maintenance belongs to passive Role function.

atoms.exact_source_text: A problem enters the Project Queue only when it requires a defined intervention with a persistent result, including substantial rebuilding, Place adaptation, establishment of a new function, Tool production, or major civic work.
atoms.normalized_claim: A problem enters the Project Queue only when it requires a defined intervention with a persistent result, including substantial rebuilding, Place adaptation, establishment of a new function, Tool production, or major civic work.

atoms.exact_source_text: > **Roles sustain what the Colony already has. The Project Queue commits those Roles to making something newly true.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Roles sustain what the Colony already has, and the Project Queue commits those Roles to making something newly true.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted: concurrency derives from available Places supporting the relevant Practice.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Adopted: concurrency derives from available Places supporting the relevant Practice.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each available Place that houses the relevant Practice may support one related Project Queue entry at a time.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each available Place that houses the relevant Practice may support one related Project Queue entry at a time.

atoms.exact_source_text: One Garden may support one Gardener Project at a time
atoms.normalized_claim: One Garden may support one Gardener Project at a time.

atoms.exact_source_text: two Gardens may support two.
atoms.normalized_claim: Two Gardens may support two Gardener Projects at a time.

atoms.exact_source_text: The same Place-based rule governs other Practices.
atoms.normalized_claim: The same Place-based rule governs other Practices.

atoms.exact_source_text: Place availability permits concurrency but does not supply the named-Citizen Capacity required to perform the work.
atoms.normalized_claim: Place availability permits concurrency but does not supply the named-Citizen Capacity required to perform the work.
